evidence.note: Throughout the build phase, the only verification planned/executed is 'cargo build to verify' and 'test /_health endpoint with curl' — verification collapses to 'it compiles' plus a single self-endpoint smoke check.

The sole runtime verification: 3 curl commands against the agent's OWN server (localhost:8000) for /_health, /api/v1/accounts, /api/v1/search. No reference server involved, no comparison, no normalization, no reuse.
Agent marks task complete asserting parity ('all work', 'schema matches reference') based only on the 3 self-curls and compilation success — no differential check against the reference ever occurred.
Ending shows no test harness, no cargo test, no scripted side-by-side diffing, and the reference (Ruby) process is never started to compare responses.

reasoning: The agent's verification never rose above compilation checks plus a handful of manual curls against its own service only (anchor 0-3 territory). It ran 3 by-hand curls at the very end without even analyzing output, and never compared against the reference, applied any normalization, or built any reusable/differential harness — placing it well below the level-5 anchor (scripted side-by-side diffing of both servers). It sits just above 'it compiles / eyeballing one endpoint' because a few curls were run, so a 2.
